Name: Deluxe Sheds
Author: KittyKaninka
Description:
[size=4][b]Tired of running out of cellar space?[/b][/size]

[size=2]This mod adds to new upgrades to the large shed.[/size]

[size=2][b]The deluxe shed:[/b] Is an even bigger version of the normal shed.[/size]
[size=2][b]The cellar shed:[/b] Is the same size as the deluxe shed, except you can use casks here.[/size]

Manifest.Name: Deluxe Sheds
Manifest.Description: Adds the option to upgrade large sheds into deluxe sheds or cellar sheds, which can hold casks.
Manifest.Author: KittyKaninka
